name: SPY vs QQQ Rolling 20-Day Correlation
description: Rolling 20-day Pearson correlation between SPY and QQQ daily returns over the past 2 years. Includes a shaded band highlighting periods of extremely high correlation (above 0.8) and a summary stats table with mean, min, max, and % of days above 0.8.
source:
# SPY vs QQQ Rolling 20-Day Correlation
# Measures how closely SPY and QQQ daily returns move together
# Shaded band highlights extreme co-movement (corr > 0.8)

# ============================================================================
# DATA
# ============================================================================

spy = market_data_source()()
qqq = reference_stocks(ticker='QQQ')()

# Daily returns (close-to-close)
spy_ret = returns(period=1)(spy.c)
qqq_ret = returns(period=1)(qqq.c)

# ============================================================================
# ROLLING 20-DAY CORRELATION
# ============================================================================

corr_20d = rolling_corr(window=20, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=spy_ret, y=qqq_ret)

# ============================================================================
# SUMMARY STATS
# ============================================================================

# Flag days where correlation is above 0.8 (high co-movement regime)
is_high_corr = is_valid(corr_20d) and corr_20d > 0.8
high_corr_flag = 1.0 if (is_valid(corr_20d) and corr_20d > 0.8) else 0.0
any_valid_flag = 1.0 if is_valid(corr_20d) else 0.0

# ============================================================================
# CHART — Rolling Correlation with High-Correlation Band
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Is SPY/QQQ Correlation Unusually High Right Now?',
    category='SPY vs QQQ Correlation',
    y_axis_label='20-Day Rolling Correlation',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=0.8, to=1.0, color=Color.Blue, opacity=0.12, label='High Co-Movement (>0.8)')
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.8, title='0.8 Threshold', color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20d Correlation (Returns)', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=index(), y_values=corr_20d)

# ============================================================================
# SUMMARY TABLE — Key Stats
# ============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='SPY vs QQQ Correlation Stats (20-Day Rolling)',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Correlation'],
        col_headers=['Mean', 'Min', 'Max', '% Days > 0.8'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='SPY vs QQQ Correlation',
    order=2
)(corr_20d, corr_20d, corr_20d, high_corr_flag)
